generation_process_record.process: Local filesystem enumeration, byte hashing, JSON parsing, source-section inspection, and execution of the named field-presence validator against each matching file.

provenance_disclaimer.sha256_scope: Each SHA-256 identifies the bytes present when this manifest was generated. It does not prove origin, author, retrieval time, or source authenticity.
provenance_disclaimer.filesystem_mtime_scope: Filesystem mtime is mutable local metadata. It is not retrieved_at and is not a cryptographic retrieval attestation.
provenance_disclaimer.process_record_scope: The manifest process record reports this local inspection only. It is not a signed or cryptographic retrieval attestation and does not establish collection history.
provenance_disclaimer.stated_as_of_scope: stated_as_of is copied from each result. It is not independently verified. Every result states 2026-09-13, later than the declared 2026-09-12 UTC decision cutoff.
provenance_disclaimer.access_date_scope: The earlier UTC+08/local-date explanation is only an unverified legacy process narrative. Labels such as access_date, as_of, accessed, observed, or snapshot accessed establish no host timezone, actual UTC retrieval time, or compliance with the 2026-09-12T23:59:59Z decision cutoff.
provenance_disclaimer.missing_lineage: The corpus has no retrieved_at, run_id/research_run, snapshot_unavailable_reason, or evidence_family_id keys. One parsed content_digest key exists, which is not corpus-wide source snapshot lineage.
provenance_disclaimer.conclusion: This manifest establishes local byte identity and field-presence results only. It does not repair or validate source provenance, semantic entailment, or cutoff compliance. A fresh immutable re-fetch plus human semantic review is a PRE-IMPLEMENTATION gate that blocks Increment 1; it is not implementation-time work.

json_syntax.meaning: All enumerated files parsed with Python json.load.

structural_completeness.meaning: The bundled research-deep validator found every required fields.yaml field name somewhere in each JSON object.
structural_completeness.limits: Presence-only structural coverage. It does not validate source-record shape, value types/nonemptiness, dates, URLs, provenance, claim/source edges, truth, entailment, conflicts, independence, efficacy, safety, compliance, or ROI.

semantic_evidence_validation.meaning: No semantic or provenance validation may be inferred from structural pass results.

validation_layers.historical_receipt_note: research/self-managing-software-projects/validation.txt records a prior 14/14, 19/19-field pass but has no run identity, timestamp, or validator digest. This manifest reran the current bundled validator for all 37 files and records its digest; that rerun remains structural only.

source_inventory_summary.counting_note: A source record is one list element or one numbered bibliography entry. A source URL is one HTTP(S) occurrence in the record URL field/string. Counts do not represent independent evidence families.
